fields.summary_ko.0: GF Securities lowered its price target for Dell Technologies (DELL) to $341 and maintained a 'Buy/Hold' rating, judging there is no meaningful upside at current prices.
fields.summary_ko.1: DELL has declined over 45% from its year-to-date high, with enterprise server shipments in fiscal 2027 expected to fall 9%, while weak PC shipments are also expected to hinder recovery.
fields.summary_ko.2: Wall Street consensus still maintains a 'Strong Buy' rating on DELL with an average price target of approximately $587, suggesting substantial upside from current levels.
